title: TuringPAI: A Foundation for On-Device Physical AI
title_zh: TuringPAI：面向端侧 Physical AI 的基础模型
abstract_en: Physical AI requires models that understand spatial relationships and dynamic environments and translate observations into actions under limited onboard compute. We present TuringPAI, a family of models for on-device Physical AI comprising TuringPAI-VL for shared vision-language understanding, TuringPAI-Drive for autonomous driving, and TuringPAI-Embodied for robotic manipulation. TuringPAI-VL is a 0.65B model built on HybridViT-MLQ, which combines convolutional local aggregation with Transformer-based global modeling. Multi-scale Latent Queries integrate spatial features and observation history within the same visual Transformer, providing a compact, structured interface to the language model. Training combines general vision-language data with geometric, cross-view, and temporal supervision. TuringPAI-VL supports general multimodal understanding and improves quantitative geometric perception over Qwen2-VL-2B, while providing a shared initialization for the two downstream VLA models. For autonomous driving, TuringPAI-Drive maintains all evaluated ADE/FDE metrics within 1.2\% of a full-token HybridViT baseline using the MLQ interface and achieves comparable aggregate scores in an in-house simulation evaluation. Using XPeng Native Runtime (XNRT) on a single NVIDIA Orin-X SoC, TuringPAI-Drive generates trajectories at 12\,Hz in on-vehicle operation. For robotic manipulation, TuringPAI-Embodied achieves a 96.8\% average success rate across the four LIBERO suites. These results demonstrate a shared vision-language foundation for driving and robotic manipulation under practical on-device constraints.
abstract_zh: Physical AI 需要在有限的端侧算力下理解空间关系和动态环境，并将观测转化为行动。本文提出 TuringPAI，由共享视觉语言模型 TuringPAI-VL、自动驾驶模型 TuringPAI-Drive 和机器人操作模型 TuringPAI-Embodied 组成。TuringPAI-VL 采用 0.65B 参数的 HybridViT-MLQ 架构，结合卷积的局部特征聚合与 Transformer 的全局建模，并通过多尺度潜在查询（Multi-scale Latent Queries，MLQ）在同一个视觉 Transformer 中整合空间特征和历史观测，为语言模型提供紧凑且结构化的输入。训练融合通用视觉语言数据与几何、跨视角和时序监督。TuringPAI-VL 支持通用多模态理解，在几何感知的定量评测中优于 Qwen2-VL-2B，并为两个下游视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）提供共享初始化。TuringPAI-Drive 使用 MLQ 接口后，各项 ADE/FDE 指标与使用完整视觉 token 的 HybridViT 基线相差不超过 1.2%，内部仿真的综合得分也与基线相当；借助 XPeng Native Runtime（XNRT），该模型在单颗 NVIDIA Orin-X SoC 上实车运行时以 12 Hz 生成轨迹。TuringPAI-Embodied 在 LIBERO 的四个任务套件上取得 96.8% 的平均成功率。
key_points_zh: 0.65B 参数的 TuringPAI-VL 为驾驶和机器人操作共用的视觉语言基础模型，几何感知定量表现优于 Qwen2-VL-2B。
HybridViT-MLQ 结合卷积的局部聚合与 Transformer 的全局建模，通过多尺度潜在查询将空间特征和历史观测整合为紧凑的视觉表征。
TuringPAI-Drive 各项 ADE/FDE 指标与完整 token 基线相差不超过 1.2%，在单颗 NVIDIA Orin-X SoC 上实车运行时以 12 Hz 生成轨迹。
TuringPAI-Embodied 在 LIBERO 四个任务套件上的平均成功率为 96.8%。
